title: GTA 6: Sensor Tower estimates 6.08M US digital pre-orders by 13 Oct (~$594M), 148% ahead of MW2 (2022) at the same point; 74% PlayStation

sources.name: GamesIndustry.biz, 'Sensor Tower data shows the yawning gap between GTA 6 and everything else' (Lewis Packwood)

claims.text: 6.08M pre-orders as of 13 Oct, est. revenue $594M (US digital only)
148% ahead of Modern Warfare 2 (2022) at this point before launch
74% PlayStation, 26% Xbox; vast majority the $100 Ultimate Edition
Rockstar has not announced pre-order figures

why: A month before launch, the biggest number in games right now; framed as estimates throughout

notes: Sensor Tower's own post not found (search 11:02Z); the 6.08M figure circulated earlier via a fan account, the MW2 comparison is new today. Grammar review: no required edits.
